question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: '**few**' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Few**" means a small number or amount, indicating scarcity or rarity. (एक छोटी संख्या या राशि, जो कमी या दुर्लभता का संकेत देती है) • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as the other options do not make sense in the given context. • Grammatically, "**few**" is a determiner that is used with plural countable nouns to indicate a small quantity. • **For example**: *There were only a few people at the party.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Little**" is an adjective that means a small amount or quantity, but it is used with uncountable nouns. (छोटी मात्रा या मात्रा, लेकिन इसका प्रयोग अनगिनत संज्ञाओं के साथ किया जाता है) • "**Significant**" means important or meaningful, but it does not fit the context of the sentence. (महत्वपूर्ण या सार्थक) • "**Least**" is a superlative adjective that means the smallest or lowest, but it does not fit the context of the sentence. (सबसे छोटा या निम्नतम) 48:Ta11, The correct answer is: **Belongings**
